# git nah works incorrectly with git submodules

Make `git nah` ([#158](DOT-157.md)) reset a repository that has submodules:

```
git nah
HEAD is now at 8f68377d9 ...
error: the following file has local modifications:
    resources/public_api/specs
(use --cached to keep the file, or -f to force removal)
fatal: Submodule work tree 'resources/public_api/specs' contains local modifications; use '-f' to discard them
```

`git reset --hard && git clean -df` does not touch submodule work trees, so a submodule with local changes survives the "throw everything away" command and blocks the subsequent operation. The note lists the options considered:

```
-> git submodule deinit --all --force

-? git submodule foreach --recursive git reset --hard
-? git submodule update -f --recursive
-? git restore . --recurse-submodules
-? git reset --hard --recurse-submodule
```
